cohort: 5,633 pregnant women who gave birth between January 2010 and April 2013
finding: Women with overt diabetes (ODM) had increased rates of premature birth, emergent cesarean section, preeclampsia, and large-for-gestational-age babies compared with women with gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: The study found that women with overt diabetes (ODM) had increased rates of emergent cesarean section compared to those with gestational diabetes (GDM).
